name: B10-0246/2025 – § 5 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text: 5. Stresses that the proposal for a regulation on a public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation(EU) No 1024/2012(COM/2024/531), which should lead to strengthened enforcement, must not lead to a decline in wages and working conditions and a race to the bottom;
